A tip, support, or donation reference alone does not establish a required payment, promised return, or deceptive mechanism.

opening.argument: The video pairs unusually large prospective price gains with an explicit route for viewers to support the creator. The forecast reaches as high as $11, while the description supplies a donation link. Together, those elements can function as a solicitation around the token’s appreciation narrative, even though the video does not spell out a purchase instruction. The evidence does not establish that the forecast is independently verified or that the proposed upgrade will pass; viewers are instead given a bullish case alongside a direct external action.
